  Line or code reference: line 433 — `default_branch()` fallback `git ls-remote --symref origin HEAD`
  Problem: The LAST RUN DIFF hardened `remote_branch_tip()` (line 503) and `fetch_from_origin()` (line 522) with `env GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` to prevent credential prompts from hanging the hook, but the pre-existing `git ls-remote --symref origin HEAD` call in `default_branch()` at line 433 is a network-bound git call with the same credential-prompt risk and was not hardened.
  Why it fails at runtime: If the origin remote requires credentials and no credential helper is configured, this `ls-remote` will block waiting for interactive input until the 5-second `_GIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` fires. The workflow-templates mirror at line 433 has the same gap.
